title: Label output
description: One JSON file per label. File name: the label_id with ':' replaced by '_' (dsld:60563 -> dsld_60563.json). review_queue.json and run_report.json use $defs/review_queue and $defs/run_report.

rows.description: Part A. One item per ingredient row, in label order, including the other_ingredients rows.

claims.description: Part B. Claims from claims.md that this label makes. At most one item per claim_id.

candidates.description: Part B. Text that looks like a product claim (diet, free from, certification, origin, form, audience, contains) but is not on the claim list. Health and function statements are not candidates.

for_a_person.description: Part B. Items a person must decide: conflicts, claims with an exception, unclear text.

evidence.description: Part C. One item per row with status 'identified'. No item for a row with status 'review'.

row_id.description: The row_id from labels.jsonl. If one input row names several substances, split it into r5.1, r5.2, ... . If the label has no rows in labels.jsonl, make them from raw_text as x1, x2, ... in label order.

verbatim.description: The row text as the label gives it.

parent.description: Parent ingredient or organism, lower case (magnesium, lactobacillus acidophilus). Null when the row is not one substance, for example a named blend.

form.description: Chemical or physical form (magnesium glycinate, extract). Null if the label gives none.

source.description: Plant part, organism or material it comes from (leaf, seed, fish). Null if the label gives none.

strain.description: Strain code for a microorganism (La-14, NCFM). Null otherwise.

role.description: blend_header = the row that names a blend; blend_member = a row inside a blend; excipient = an other ingredient.

group.description: row_id of the blend header that contains this row. Null for a row that is not inside a blend.

blend_contents.description: Blend headers only: listed = the label names the members; not_disclosed = it does not. Null for every other role.

identity.description: One public id from a lookup. A review row may carry the nearest id (for example the species of a strain) or null.

status.description: identified = the id is for exactly what the row names. review = a person must check; give a reason.

reason.description: Required for review: a short code, then optional detail after ': ' (strain_no_id: no NCBI id for strain Lg-36). review_queue.json counts by the code. Null for identified.

amount.description: The amount on the label. value and unit are null when the label gives no amount.

scope.description: What the amount covers: ingredient = this row alone; blend = the whole blend (header); member = one member of a blend. Null for an excipient.

system.description: Use pubchem_cid when the substance has one, unii when it has no CID, ncbi_taxid for an organism.

id.description: The id as the source gives it.

lookup_url.description: A URL that shows this id at the source.

quote.description: Exact substring of the label's raw_text.

where.description: The labels.jsonl field that holds the quote. Use raw_text when no other field holds it.

phrase.description: The claim-like phrase, lower case, normalized.

quote.description: Exact substring of the label's raw_text.

kind.description: conflict = two parts of the label disagree; exception = a claim with a limit; unclear = you cannot decide by rule.

quote.description: Exact substring of the label's raw_text.

row_id.description: An identified row of this label.

source.description: The one public source you fetched.

status.description: record = the source has a hazard record for this id. no_record = it has none. no_record never means safe.

summary.description: What the record says, in short. Null for no_record.

copy_path.description: Path of the stored copy of the response, relative to the output folder.

review.description: Rows with status review, counted by reason code.

candidates.description: Number of candidate items, all labels.

for_a_person.description: Number of for_a_person items, all labels.

no_record.description: Number of evidence items with status no_record.

version.description: Git commit SHA or a hash of the code.
